name: Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal
kurzbeschreibung: The serene baroque pilgrimage church Maria Thal near Kufstein enchants at the forest edge with a late-Gothic Madonna and deep spiritual peace.
beschreibung:
Overview

The idyllically situated Pilgrimage Church Maria Thal (also known as the sanctuary of Thal am Thiersee) rests along a gentle wooded slope at around 700 meters elevation near the fortress town of Kufstein and the Passion Play village of Thiersee. Nestled amidst lush alpine meadows and tranquil mixed woodlands beneath the towering limestone ramparts of the Kaiser Mountains and the Thiersee Valley, this intimate Marian sanctuary has served for centuries as a haven of silent prayer, reflection, and spiritual retreat for pilgrims and hikers across Tyrol and Bavaria.

Route & Requirements

The pilgrimage tradition at Thal dates back to the late 15th century. According to local lore, a humble wooden wayside shrine initially marked the site where herdsmen and travelers prayed for protection against alpine storms and hardship. Following accounts of answered prayers and miraculous recoveries, a first Gothic chapel was erected around 1500. The church owes its present architectural grace to baroque rebuilding and enlargement in the 17th and early 18th centuries, when pilgrimage reached its golden zenith. The sacred centerpiece is the late-Gothic miraculous image of Our Lady of Thal—an exquisitely carved wooden Madonna and Child from the early 16th century, enshrined beneath a gilded baroque altar surrounded by angel figures. Numerous historic votive tablets on the sanctuary walls bear moving testimony to regional folk piety and heartfelt gratitude for deliverance from illness and wartime peril.

Visit & Arrival

The Pilgrimage Church Maria Thal is open daily year-round to visitors and worshippers free of charge (generally accessible from 08:00 to 18:00). Festive pilgrimage masses are held on Marian feast days and Sundays. Arriving by public transport: take ÖBB or regional trains to Kufstein international station, then take regional bus line 4046 toward Thiersee to the Thal stop; the church is just a short stroll from the stop. By car: from the Inntal autobahn A12, take exit Kufstein Nord, follow the Thierseestraße L37 uphill toward Thiersee, and follow the signposts to Thal; parking spaces are situated directly beneath the church knoll.

Tips

Access to the church is largely level and barrier-free, allowing straightforward visits with strollers or light wheelchair assistance. The peaceful bench sheltered beneath old linden trees in front of the church portal offers a charming resting spot following a circuit walk around nearby Lake Thiersee or along the Kufstein forest nature trail. Visit in the late afternoon when warm sunlight pours gently through the sanctuary windows.
